content:
**1) LAYOUT**
*   **Window:** 1024x768 (Maximized). Standard Windows 11 chrome (Title bar, Min/Max/Close).
*   **Header Bar (Top):** [0, 0] to [1024, 120]. Contains navigation, location bar, and action buttons.
    *   **App Title/Logo:** [10, 15] to [220, 45].
    *   **Action Buttons (Right):** "Buy Now" [680, 15], Settings/Help icons, Window controls.
    *   **Navigation Toolbar:** [0, 60] to [1024, 115]. Home/Back/Forward buttons [10, 70], Location Breadcrumb [170, 70], View Toggle (List) [650, 75], Filter Button [700, 75], Search Bar [790, 70].
*   **Main Content Area (Middle):** [0, 125] to [1024, 815]. Split into three vertical panes.
    *   **Left Pane (Tree View):** [0, 125] to [275, 815]. Contains "Path"/"Type" tabs and a directory tree.
    *   **Center Pane (File List):** [280, 125] to [790, 815]. Contains column headers (Name, Date, Type) and a list of folders.
    *   **Right Pane (Preview/Details):** [795, 125] to [1024, 815]. Shows preview of selected item.
*   **Status Bar / Scanning Footer (Bottom):** [0, 815] to [1024, 950]. Full width. Contains progress indicator, stats, and primary actions.
*   **Windows Taskbar:** [0, 950] to [1024, 1000].

**2) TEXT (Verbatim)**
*   **Title Bar:** "EaseUS Data Recovery Wizard Free"
*   **Buttons:** "Buy Now", "Filter", "Search files or folders"
*   **Location Bar:** "Windows (C:)"
*   **Tabs:** "Path", "Type"
*   **Tree Items:**
    *   "Windows (C:)" | "1.1M"
    *   "File Path Lost" | "4.3K"
    *   "Reconstructed" | "7"
*   **List Headers:** "Name", "Date Modified", "Type"
*   **List Items (Sample):**
    *   "actionarchivecache" | "10/7/2026 11:30 PM" | "File folder"
    *   "actions-runner" | "10/17/2026 6:11 PM" | "File folder"
    *   "azureCli" | "10/8/2026 1:50 AM" | "File folder"
    *   "cobertura-2.1.1" | "2/26/2015 11:23 PM" | "File folder"
    *   "ghcup" | "10/8/2026 12:32 AM" | "File folder"
    *   "hostedtoolcache" | "10/7/2026 11:25 PM" | "File folder"
    *   "image" | "10/7/2026 9:08 PM" | "File folder"
    *   "inetpub" | "10/7/2026 10:10 PM" | "File folder"
    *   "Julia" | "10/7/2026 11:21 PM" | "File folder"
    *   "mingw32" | "2/19/2026 12:59 PM" | "File folder"
*   **Right Pane:**
    *   "actionarchivecache"
    *   "Open"
    *   "Size": "7.29 MB"
    *   "Date Modified": "10/7/2026 11:30 PM"
    *   "Path": "C:\"
*   **Scanning Strip (Blue):** "Searching: ...\\00040000000A9FB273B246C9\\Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.CSharp.resources.dll"
*   **Footer Stats:**
    *   "22%" (Inside gauge)
    *   "Advanced Scanning , Files Found: 1139164 (146.29 GB)"
    *   "Remaining time: 10m16s"
    *   "Reading sector: 63946752/313413598"
*   **Footer Buttons:** "Recover All ..."
*   **System Tray:** "6:17 PM", "10/17/2026"

**3) COLOR (Estimated Hex)**
*   **Backgrounds:**
    *   App Background: `#FFFFFF` (White)
    *   List Item Selected: `#D6E8FF` (Light Blue)
    *   List Item Hover (implied): `#F5F5F5` (Light Gray)
    *   Scanning Strip Background: `#E6F2FF` (Very Light Blue)
    *   Footer Background: `#F9F9F9` (Off-white/Light Gray)
*   **Accents & Text:**
    *   Primary Brand Blue: `#2D8EFF` (Used for "Buy Now", "Open", "Recover All", Gauge Ring, Icons)
    *   Text Primary: `#333333` (Dark Gray/Black)
    *   Text Secondary: `#666666` or `#888888` (Gray, used for dates, file counts)
    *   Text Link/Path: `#0066CC` (Blue, used in scanning strip path)
*   **Borders:**
    *   Pane Dividers: `#E0E0E0` (Light Gray)
    *   Input Fields: `#CCCCCC`

**4) TYPOGRAPHY**
*   **Font Family:** Segoe UI (Standard Windows UI font).
*   **Sizes:**
    *   Title Bar: 12px (Regular)
    *   Headers (Name, Date): 13px (Regular/Semibold)
    *   List Items: 13px (Regular)
    *   Tree Items: 13px (Regular)
    *   Footer Status ("Advanced Scanning..."): 14px (Semibold)
    *   Footer Details ("Remaining time..."): 12px (Regular)
    *   Gauge Percentage: 18px (Bold)

**5) SPACING & SIZING**
*   **Gauge:** Diameter approx 70px. Stroke width approx 6-8px.
*   **List Row Height:** Approx 40-42px.
*   **Icon Size (List/Tree):** 24x24px or 32x32px (looks like standard large icon view or medium).
*   **Button Heights:**
    *   Header buttons: 32px
    *   "Open" / "Recover All": 36-40px
*   **Padding:**
    *   List Item Left Padding: ~10px (after checkbox/icon).
    *   Pane Gutter: ~5px (draggable resize handle).
*   **Border Radius:**
    *   Buttons: 4px - 6px.
    *   Search/Input fields: 4px.

**6) CONTROLS & STATES**
*   **Checkbox (Square):** Unchecked state visible in list and tree.
*   **Tree View:** Expanded state on "Windows (C:)". Collapsed on others.
*   **List View:** Single selection active on "actionarchivecache".
*   **Progress Gauge:** Circular, 22% fill.
*   **Buttons:**
    *   "Buy Now": Normal (Orange/Yellow accent).
    *   "Filter": Normal (Ghost/Button with icon).
    *   "Open": Normal (Primary Blue, solid).
    *   "Recover All ...": Normal (Primary Blue, solid).
    *   Pause Icon (||): Visible next to gauge.
    *   Stop Icon (Square): Visible next to pause.
    *   History/Clock Icon: Visible in footer right.
*   **Search Bar:** Placeholder text "Search files or folders".

**7) ICONOGRAPHY**
*   **Style:** Flat, Outline/Filled hybrid (mostly filled for actions, outline for navigation).
*   **Specifics:**
    *   Folder icons: Standard Windows 11 style folder (blue/yellow).
    *   Navigation: Home, Left Arrow, Up Arrow (Outline).
    *   Actions: List view (lines), Filter (funnel), Search (magnifying glass), Pause (two bars), Stop (square), Clock (history).
    *   App Logo: Circular symbol in bottom right of content area (purple/blue gradient).

**8) STATE**
*   **Page State:** **Active Processing / Scanning**.
*   **Context:** The application is currently performing an "Advanced Scan". It is not idle. The user can interact with the file list (browsing found files) while the scan proceeds in the background (indicated by the footer strip and progress gauge).
*   **Motion Cues:**
    *   The blue "Searching..." strip implies active disk reading.
    *   The circular gauge at 22% indicates progress.
    *   The "Remaining time" counter implies a live timer.
    *   No explicit loading spinner is visible in the center, suggesting the background scan doesn't block the UI thread.
